svg.aria-label: The journey: a logarithmic spiral growing by phi every turn, from the Age of Reason at the centre to the Age of Engagement. Each turn is one 4D loop: discover, develop, design, deploy. A Business Equation reading at every discover. You transform your people, to transition your organisation, to transcend your market.
